verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only generic integration paths: an official MCP server that MCP-capable agent frameworks could consume, official SDKs, and CDP WebSocket endpoints for Playwright and Puppeteer. The 'built in support for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, BrowserUse' line describes agents that Hyperbrowser itself runs, not adapters into external frameworks. Missing for 10: documented adapters or tool packages for the Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain and CrewAI; framework-specific integration guides; independent corroboration of framework usage.
